role: Abstract registry mapping attribute definitions to their instances per entity; subclasses pick registration and name lookup behavior.

members.name: attributes
members.note: a fixed struct attr_instance a[ATTR_COUNT] array indexed by enum, not a HashMap keyed by IAttribute

members.name: attributesByName
members.note: no persistent by-name map; name strings appear only in the NBT read path

members.name: getAttributeInstance
members.note: lookup by enum index instead of object identity

members.name: getAttributeInstanceByName
members.note: exists only in the NBT load path: cp_restore_living matches the Attributes tag's Name strings against the ATTR_NAME table (entity_nbt.c player_attributes does the same for the player); no general by-name lookup

members.name: registerAttribute
members.note: the fixed six attributes are registered once at attrs_init; no runtime registration

members.name: getAllAttributes
members.note: no collection; the only consumer that walks every instance is the Attributes NBT write, which loops ATTR_COUNT entries

members.name: addAttributeInstance
members.note: watchable-instance registration for client sync; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: removeAttributeModifiers
members.note: only the potion path removes then re-applies modifiers (potion.c potion_apply_attributes); the equipment Multimap path survives as the attr_mod from_item flag that attr_instance_nbt excludes

members.name: applyAttributeModifiers
members.note: apply and remove by fixed UUID/name per potion id, not via a Multimap of item-provided modifiers

notes: The whole map is folded into struct attr_map inside struct living (living.h:299). I did not verify EntityLivingBase's equipment-changed applyAttributeModifiers path beyond the from_item flag comment in living.h. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: addAttributeInstance and the watched-instance set it feeds have no native counterpart: no client attribute sync exists. a general getAttributeInstanceByName facility does not exist; name-based matching happens only inside the NBT load functions.
